architecture.summary: Free access refuses an account whose only organization membership an Admin removed. WorkOS keeps no record of a deleted membership, so the removal coordinator of organizations writes the removed member (authority, subject, organization, membership, operation, time) to the new table thermus_admin.removed_members through the RemovedMemberStore role that joins the organizations-owned removal store contract, after its checks and before the one WorkOS deletion; a write that is not confirmed completes the operation with no-effect and the result unavailable, so that a deleted membership always has its row. App gives the same SQL adapter to the WorkOS signup adapter, which reads the row of the signed-in user last, after the product access and the membership record reads: a row gives existing-account (the notice; 403 on POST), an unavailable read gives unavailable (503), never eligibility; without hosted storage it makes no read. Public contracts change (contract, internalInterface): RemovedMember, RemovedMemberStore, and RemovalStore in removal-operation-store.ts, the removalStore option of OrganizationAdministration, and the removedMembers option of WorkOSSignup; the registry view of the hosted membership removal gains the edge of the signup read. Stored data and the deploy order change (deployment): the migration 20261102184225_removed_members.sql runs before the deploy of this control plane; without the table, member removal answers unavailable and the signup of a new account answers 503. No container, component, dependency edge, or external integration changes: the WorkOS calls are the same. Team flag sensitiveBehavior: the admission rule of organization creation and the removal flow change, and the security file workos-signup.ts changes; every existing guard stays.
